CustomField.description: Set to Pending automatically when an order that holds payments is cancelled. Staff set it to Refunded after sending the money back; that sends the client the refund_processed WhatsApp.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pending = the client paid for a cancelled order and is owed a refund. Set to Refunded once the money is sent back (add the UPI reference) and the client gets a WhatsApp confirmation.
CustomField.label: Refund Status
